title: Product Advisory Learning
about: Filmed in Learning's UI test harness (tests/ui, fake sign-in and sample learners), served by tests/ui/run-ui-tests.mjs's build at <tmp>/pa-ui-site. Run tour.mjs with --site pointing at it.

beats.say: This is Product Advisory Learning: courses, tools and audio for product managers, built around where you are today.
Your home shows your next best step: the course to do now, and what comes after it.
beats.label: Your next best step

beats.say: My growth compares your first skill check with your latest, area by area, and nudges you to retake it after ninety days.
beats.label: My growth

beats.say: Courses come in seven skill areas, at four levels each. A lesson mixes a short story, real data and practice.
beats.label: A lesson

beats.say: Every lesson has a Listen button, so you can learn on a walk or a commute.
beats.label: Listen to the lesson

beats.say: The course outline shows your progress, the key takeaways, and related listening.
beats.label: Course outline

beats.say: My Toolkits keeps the work you do in the free tools, saved to your account. You can even score a scorecard as a team.
beats.label: My Toolkits

beats.say: Listen and watch has every Product+ article, read aloud, with chapters.
beats.label: Listen & watch

beats.say: And when your company joins, admins see team skills and progress, and can assign courses with due dates.
beats.label: For teams

beats.say: Start with the free skill check, then follow your next best step. Welcome to Product Advisory Learning.
